title: Vaporize run misses CLIs installed under domain-specific bin paths

historicalContent.observedFailure: Vaporize run could miss an installed CLI when the executable was available through a domain-specific bin path rather than the flat ~/.swiftpm/bin path.
historicalContent.expectedBehavior: Vaporize should prefer inferred or explicit domain-specific installed CLI paths, discover matching domain bin entries, and only fall back to the flat bin path after domain candidates are checked.
acceptanceCriteria: installed CLI candidate resolution checks inferred domain paths before the flat bin path.
explicit domain flags produce first-priority domain candidates.
domain bin discovery can find executable products outside the current package's inferred domain.
validation errors list every checked candidate path.
CUJ-01 tests pin candidate ordering for inferred and explicit domains.
